titre: A bishop attacks your rook. Take, or run? ♟️ #chess #shorts
description:
Take his rook, or run? 👇 Only 1.Rh8+! wins: 1...Ke7 2.Kxe2 and your king takes his rook. 1.Kxe2 Bxh7 is just a trade (Stockfish 16, composed position). One new puzzle every day.
